gloss: as of; with this; effective from

definitions.gloss: as of; with this; effective from
definitions.explanation: A very formal expression used to indicate a point in time or event that marks a transition, ending, or official change. The polite form of をもって.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧をもちまして、⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧とします。
examples.english: With this, we will close the session.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧をもちまして、⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: As of today, we will cease operations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧{末日|まつじつ}をもちまして、{当店|とうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: As of the end of March, our store will be closing.

notes:
The polite/formal version of ⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧. Derived from ⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to hold/have) in its polite -ます form. Used in formal announcements, ceremonies, and official notices to mark a specific time or event as a boundary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧をもちまして: with this (closing a meeting/event)
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧をもちまして: as of today
- [date]をもちまして: effective from [date]

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- をもちまして⟦{閉会|へいかい}→閉会：23962_heikai⟧とします: we hereby close the meeting
- をもちまして⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}します→終了する：22990_shuuryousuru⟧: will end as of
- をもちまして⟦{退任|たいにん}→退任：14904_tainin⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: will resign as of

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧: formal
- をもちまして: very formal (polite form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧: as of, with — the plain formal version
- で: at, with — the everyday equivalent
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ending with — similar idea of marking a final point
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as of, starting from — emphasizes a cutoff point
